rana: Quick: preparing private/vpc installer v2.1.0 for tonight's 23:00 UTC window. Need dual-sign approach verified for legacy validators.

evan: We can attach both legacy and new-kms signatures; packaging-bot supports dual-sign now.

packaging-bot: staged /staging/offline/v2.1.0/installer.tar.gz (sha256: d4b2...9f0). chunk_count=18. awaiting cosign dual-sign.

maria: Rollout policy: canary=2, auto-rollback on checksum mismatch to v2.0.5, pause-and-triage for service-start failures. Transport TTL=3h.

packaging-bot: dual-sign complete (legacy: lg-2024-21, new: nk-2026-05). manifest pinned at /staging/offline/v2.1.0/manifest.json (sha: c7a8...33b).

deploy-bot: queued job private/vpc/offline/v2.1.0 - canary=2 - window=2026-03-21T23:00Z - job=11234. watch: https://deploy.redwood.com/jobs/11234

evan: Preflight command I ran: ./scripts/offline_validate.sh --manifest /staging/offline/v2.1.0/manifest.json --chunks 18 -> all OK.

rana: Good. Note: if a canary fails due to packaging metadata (file modes, missing symlink) we will abort and cut v2.1.0+patch. Keep artifacts for hotfix branch.

packaging-bot: canary started on worker-ops-7. fetch ok, unpack ok, service start ok.

deploy-bot: canary2 worker-ops-8 failed healthcheck: "permission denied /opt/redwood/bin/start.sh". retrying fetch.

evan: If retry fails, abort and preserve artifacts for patch.

packaging-bot: retry success; unpack ok. healthchecks pass. rolling to remaining nodes per window.

rana: Thanks all. I'll draft release notes including dual-sign guidance and manifest SHA for customers. :shipit:
